fr.elements: Main Residence; Front Entry Area; Vehicle Parking Area; Walkway; Open Lawn Area; Landscaped Area; Detached Structure; Access Drive
fr.considerations: Single Access Point; Limited Rear Access; Vegetation Near Structure
fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance visible from both directions of travel on the street.
• Keep the access drive clear of parked vehicles to allow emergency vehicles to reach the main residence without obstruction.
• Trim vegetation along the access drive that may reduce clearance for emergency vehicles or block sightlines.
• Cut back plants or shrubs near the detached structure so responders can move around it without obstruction.
• Keep a gate or passage unlocked at the rear of the property to give responders an alternate route if the front access drive is blocked.
• Mark or identify the rear access point so responders arriving at the front can quickly locate an alternate path to the back of the property.
• Keep the walkway between the main residence and detached structure clear so responders can move between the two structures without obstruction.

wildfire.conditions: Scattered Trees; Brush Area; Open Terrain; Grass Cover; Vegetation Near Structure; Scattered Shrubs; Multiple Access Routes; Adequate Vegetation Separation
wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim tree branches that hang close to or over any structures on the property.
• Thin scattered trees near structures so there is open space between their canopies and the building walls.
• Cut back brush growing within the immediate area around each structure.
• Mow or cut grass surrounding structures, particularly during dry months when grass dries out.
• Remove shrubs growing directly against or touching any structure.
• Separate shrub clusters near structures so there are gaps of bare ground between individual plants.
• Keep scattered shrubs trimmed low and away from tree canopies to reduce vertical plant connections between ground level and tree branches.
• Clear any dead grass, fallen branches, or dry plant debris that has collected against structure walls or under decks.
• Keep both access routes clear of overhanging branches and encroaching vegetation along their edges.
• Maintain open ground between the brush area and the nearest structure by cutting back the brush edge closest to buildings.
